# LiteRT-LM C headers

Unmodified upstream declarations from Google AI Edge LiteRT-LM v0.17.1,
commit `5e58e9a0aef7abf7091207a8b1d1063a1c800f08`.

Source: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT-LM/tree/5e58e9a0aef7abf7091207a8b1d1063a1c800f08/c

The upstream Apache-2.0 license is retained in `LICENSE`; headers retain their
original notices. No runtime binary or Dart plugin implementation is vendored.
The maintainer generator validates header SHA-256 values before generating.

To update: review the upstream API, acquire headers from a fixed commit,
update the generator's digests, regenerate, and qualify matching native binaries.
Do not replace headers or binaries independently based on symbol names alone.
